title: Service Manifest
description: Service identity for multi-repo federation (.dkk/service.yml). Declares this repo's service name and the bounded contexts it publishes for cross-repo consumption.

name.description: Kebab-case service identifier (e.g. "ordering"). Globally unique within an org.

exports.description: Bounded-context names this service publishes for federation.

description.description: Optional human-readable description of the service.
